symbols.signature: tally(counts: Tally, node: ast.Node, depth: int) mutates(counts)
symbols.snippet:
tally(counts: Tally, node: ast.Node, depth: int) mutates(counts):
    counts.nodes = counts.nodes + 1
    if depth > counts.depth:
        counts.depth = depth
    match node:
        case ast.Node.atom(_, _):
            counts.atoms = counts.atoms + 1
        case ast.Node.string(_, _):
            counts.strings = counts.strings + 1
        case ast.Node.integer(value, _):
            counts.ints = counts.ints + 1
            counts.values = counts.values + float(value)
        case ast.Node.decimal(value, _, _):
            counts.floats = counts.floats + 1
            counts.values = counts.values + value
        case ast.Node.measure(value, _, _):
            counts.measures = counts.measures + 1
            counts.values = counts.values + value
        case ast.Node.form(entries, _):
            counts.forms = counts.forms + 1
            for child in entries:
                tally(counts, child, depth + 1)

summarise(nodes: list[ast.Node]) -> str:
    counts = Tally(forms=0, nodes=0, atoms=0, strings=0, ints=0, floats=0, measures=0, depth=0, values=0.0)
    for node in nodes:
        tally(counts, node, 0)
    return f"forms={counts.forms} nodes={counts.nodes} atoms={counts.atoms} strings={counts.strings} ints={counts.ints} floats={counts.floats} measures={counts.measures} max_depth={counts.depth} value_sum={counts.values}"

symbols.snippet:
main(args: list[str], fs: Filesystem, out: Stream, err: Stream) -> int:
    if len(args) == 0:
        err.print("usage: main <file.sexp> [--render]")
        return 2
    path = args[0]
    render_only = len(args) > 1 and args[1] == "--render"
    source = b""
    match read_file(fs, path):
        case Ok(data):
            source = data
        case Err(problem):
            err.print("read failed:", problem)
            return 2
    match parser.parse(source):
        case Ok(nodes):
            if render_only:
                out.print(printer.render(nodes))
            else:
                out.print(summarise(nodes))
            return 0
        case Err(problem):
            err.print(f"parse error: {problem.message} at {problem.line}:{problem.col}")
            return 1

symbols.name: parse_with_depth_cap
symbols.signature: parse_with_depth_cap(src: bytes, cap: int) -> Result[list[ast.Node], ParseError]
symbols.snippet:
parse_with_depth_cap(src: bytes, cap: int) -> Result[list[ast.Node], ParseError]:
    tokens: list[tk.Token] = []
    match tk.tokenize(src):
        case Ok(lexed):
            tokens = lexed
        case Err(problem):
            return Err(lex_failure(src, problem))
    nodes: list[ast.Node] = []
    pos = 0
    while True:
        token = tokens[pos]
        if token.kind == tk.Kind.eof:
            break
        parsed = parse_node(Cursor(src=src, tokens=tokens, pos=pos, cap=cap), 0)?
        nodes.append(parsed.node)
        pos = parsed.next
    return Ok(nodes)

is_short_list(entries: list[ast.Node]) -> bool:
    total = 2
    index = 0
    while index < len(entries):
        if index > 0:
            total = total + 1
        match estimate_width(entries[index], 0):
            case Some(width):
                total = total + width
            case None:
                return False
        if total > short_list_max_width:
            return False
        index = index + 1
    return True

symbols.name: push_node
symbols.signature: push_node(parts: list[str], node: ast.Node, indent: int) mutates(parts)
symbols.snippet:
push_node(parts: list[str], node: ast.Node, indent: int) mutates(parts):
    match node:
        case ast.Node.form(entries, _):
            if len(entries) == 0:
                parts.append("()")
                return
            if is_short_list(entries):
                # Short enough (and shallow enough) for one line.
                parts.append("(")
                index = 0
                while index < len(entries):
                    if index > 0:
                        parts.append(" ")
                    push_node(parts, entries[index], indent + 2)
                    index = index + 1
                parts.append(")")
                return
            # Too wide or too deep: the first child stays on the "(" line and
            # every later child starts an indented line of its own.
            parts.append("(")
            push_node(parts, entries[0], indent + 2)
            index = 1
            while index < len(entries):
                parts.append("\n")
                push_indent(parts, indent + 2)
                push_node(parts, entries[index], indent + 2)
                index = index + 1
            parts.append(")")
            return
        case ast.Node.atom(text, _):
            parts.append(text)
            return
        case ast.Node.string(content, _):
            parts.append("\"")
            parts.append(content)
            parts.append("\"")
            return
        case ast.Node.integer(value, _):
            parts.append(str(value))
            return
        case ast.Node.decimal(value, _, literal):
            # A suffixed literal prints as it was written; re-deriving the text
            # from the f64 would rewrite `100nF` as `0.0000001`.
            match literal:
                case Some(text):
                    parts.append(text)
                case None:
                    parts.append(render_float(value))
            return
        case ast.Node.measure(value, _, literal):
            # A dimension prints as it was written; only a spelling-less node
            # falls back to the normalised millimetre value plus "mm".
            match literal:
                case Some(text):
                    parts.append(text)
                case None:
                    parts.append(render_float(value))
                    parts.append("mm")
            return
